lines.en: Long body, sways in the breeze.

lines.zh: 蠕虫般的身体在空中打卷。
lines.en: Its wormlike body curls in the air.

lines.zh: 它顺着末地的气流向上漂。
lines.en: It drifts upward on the End's slow currents.

lines.zh: 悬在末地高空，几乎不动。
lines.en: It hangs high over the End, barely moving.
The little flock drifts loosely together.

lines.zh: 细长的身体随气流打转。
lines.en: Its slender body turns with the draft.

lines.zh: 它张开嘴，接住飘过的尘埃。
lines.en: It opens its mouth to catch passing dust.
Stares at the player, ready to strike.
Stares at the player, ready to eat.
Stares at the player, ready to act.
It dips its head to look down at you.

lines.zh: 它绕着你上方飘了一圈。
lines.en: It drifts a slow circle above you.
Wobbles in the air from exhaustion
Its long body curls into a knot.

lines.zh: 细长身体飘浮起，诱饵光芒闪烁起。
lines.en: Slim body rises, luring light flickers.

lines.zh: 蠕虫形身躯摇曳，末地能量吸引你。
lines.en: Worm-like form sways, end energy draws you in.

lines.zh: 轻盈身姿轻颤动，引诱你靠近前来。
lines.en: Graceful body quivers, enticing you near.

lines.zh: 漂浮空中如细线，吸引你品尝其味。
lines.en: Floating high like a thread, enticing you with its taste.

lines.zh: 细长体态轻盈舞，吸引你品尝其味。
lines.en: Graceful, slender form dances, enticing you with its taste.

lines.zh: 蠕虫状身体轻盈，引来你好奇一尝。
lines.en: Slimy worm-like form, enticing you to taste.

lines.zh: 轻盈身躯在空中，引诱你前来享用。
lines.en: Graceful body in the air, enticing you to feast.

lines.zh: 轻盈漂浮如游丝，引来你品尝其味。
lines.en: Floating lightly like a thread, enticing you with its taste.

lines.zh: 细长身躯在空舞，引诱你品尝其味。
lines.en: Graceful, slender form in the air, enticing you with its taste.

lines.zh: 轻盈漂浮如游丝，引诱你品尝其味。
lines.en: Floating lightly like a thread, enticing you with its taste.

lines.zh: 突兀相撞如触电，身体飘忽消散无踪。
lines.en: Sudden collision, body vanishes in a flash.

lines.zh: 与之碰撞如触电，身体消散无影踪。
lines.en: Collision sends shock, body vanishes in an instant.

lines.zh: 突兀相撞如触电，身体随即消失无踪。
轻盈身躯相撞碎，随即消失无影踪。
lines.en: Graceful body shatters, vanishing in an instant.

lines.zh: 碰撞触电般瞬间，身体轻盈消散无踪。
lines.en: Collision sends shock, body vanishes instantly.

lines.zh: 轻盈身躯相撞碎，随之消失无影踪。
相撞如触电瞬间，身体轻盈消失无踪。
lines.en: Collision sends shock, body vanishes instantly.

lines.zh: 轻盈身躯相碰撞，随即消失无影踪。

lines.en: One touch and it thins into mist.

lines.zh: 撞上来时轻得像一口气。
lines.en: It bumps you light as a breath.

lines.zh: 轻盈游动找伴侣，偶遇共舞空中。
lines.en: Gently drift to find a mate,偶遇共舞空中.

lines.zh: 漂浮空中偶相遇，共舞成为伴侣。
lines.en: Meet in the air, dancing to be partners.

lines.zh: 轻盈游动寻伴侣，空中共舞成双。
lines.en: Gently drift to find a mate, dancing in the air.

lines.zh: 轻盈身躯共舞飞，空中偶遇成双。
lines.en: Graceful bodies dance, meeting in the air.

lines.zh: 空中轻盈共舞飞，偶遇成双为伴侣。
lines.en: Gentle flight, meeting in the air, becoming partners.

lines.zh: 轻盈游动空中飞，偶遇共舞为伴。
lines.en: Gently drift, meeting in the air, dancing as partners.

lines.zh: 轻盈共舞空中飞，偶遇成双伴侣。
lines.en: Gentle flight, meeting, dancing as partners.

lines.zh: 轻盈游动空中飞，共舞成为伴侣。
lines.en: Gently drift, meeting in the air, becoming partners.

lines.zh: 两条细影在空中绞在一起。
lines.en: Two thin shadows twist together in the air.

lines.zh: 它们首尾相衔，慢慢上浮。
lines.en: They join head to tail and slowly rise.
Silent drift, adapted to the End
Dust for sustenance, purifying the End

lines.zh: 它感觉到了空中的微尘。
lines.en: It senses dust drifting in the air.

lines.zh: 末地砂砾的粉末飘了过来。
lines.en: A puff of End sand drifts past.

lines.zh: 它朝浮游的碎屑偏过头。
lines.en: It tilts toward the floating grit.

lines.zh: 振动很轻，它还是察觉了。
lines.en: The tremor is faint. It notices anyway.

lines.zh: 它慢慢降到尘埃的高度。
lines.en: It sinks slowly to the dust's level.

lines.zh: 长吻对准那团漂浮的粉末。
lines.en: Its long snout aims at the drifting powder.

lines.zh: 它无声地绕过末地石柱。
lines.en: It slips silently around an End pillar.

lines.zh: 细身一寸寸靠近那粒微尘。
lines.en: Its thin body closes on the speck inch by inch.

lines.zh: 它把嘴张成一个小小的圆。
lines.en: It opens its mouth into a small round O.
It opens wide and pulls in a swirl of dust.

lines.zh: 长吻扫过，带起一片碎屑。
lines.en: Its snout sweeps through, lifting debris.

lines.zh: 它用身体把你轻轻推开。
lines.en: It nudges you away with its body.
It hits you and comes apart.

lines.zh: 空中的细影抽在你肩上。
lines.en: A thin shadow in the air whips your shoulder.

lines.zh: 末地高空多了一条细影。
lines.en: Another thin shadow joins the End sky.

lines.zh: 它从末地石缝里挤出来。
lines.en: It squeezes out of a crack in the End stone.
A small flock drifts slowly into view.

lines.zh: 末地的空气轻轻震动了一下。

lines.en: It takes shape out of the dust.

lines.zh: 高处传来极轻的蠕动声。
lines.en: A faint writhing sound comes from above.
